headline: Trump says Google kisses his ass
summary: Donald Trump claimed Google was subservient to him during his second term. He boasted about his influence at a Kentucky rally. Trump also mentioned renaming bodies of water as accomplishments.

headline: The best gadget I bought this year is a milk frother
summary: The author shares their unexpected obsession with a milk frother after discovering a unique matcha drink. This simple gadget allows them to create coffee shop-quality cold foam at home. It has become their favorite new tech purchase of the year.

headline: How overhead projectors took over your classroom
summary: Overhead projectors, initially used for military purposes, transformed classroom dynamics. This technology ended the era of teachers constantly facing the chalkboard. It significantly impacted both teaching methods and student discipline.

headline: Cities want to put the boot on robotaxis
summary: Cities across the country are increasingly pushing back against the expansion of robotaxi services. New laws and regulations are being introduced to control autonomous vehicles. The article explores the evolving legal and policy landscape for self-driving cars.

headline: Dev Behind Russian Roulette Drinking Game Cancels Steam Demo Plans Following AI Copycat Concerns
summary: The developer of the anime-style Russian roulette game, Drunken Goddess Reflux, canceled its Steam demo. The decision stems from significant concerns about potential AI copycats. This highlights growing anxieties among developers regarding intellectual property and AI technology.

headline: Battlefield 6 Devs Respond After Players Take Aim at 'Secuty' Typo and Cosmetic With 5 Pistols
summary: Battlefield 6 developers addressed player criticisms regarding recent Season 5 cosmetic additions. Players specifically called out a 'Secuty' typo and a controversial cosmetic featuring five pistols. The dev team responded to community feedback concerning these in-game issues.

headline: James Cameron Congratulates Marvel After Avengers: Endgame Beats Avatar at the Box Office Yet Again
summary: Avengers: Endgame once again surpassed Avatar to reclaim the title of top-grossing film. Director James Cameron publicly congratulated Marvel on this box office achievement. The two blockbuster movies have repeatedly swapped the number one spot.

headline: Ben Affleck's Batman Movie Would Have Featured Arkham Asylum-Inspired Deathstroke Fight and DCEU Batgirl, Joe Manganiello Reveals
summary: Joe Manganiello disclosed new plot details about Ben Affleck's unproduced Batman movie. The film was set to feature an intense Arkham Asylum-inspired battle with Deathstroke. It also planned to include the DCEU's Batgirl in a significant role.

headline: Burnt out cars and shattered glass on Paris streets after protests turn to riots and looting
summary: Paris experienced widespread destruction as protests escalated into riots and looting. Burnt-out cars and shattered glass were seen across the city's streets. Approximately 1,800 people were arrested nationwide following the outbreaks of violence.

headline: Watch: Parisians wake up to protest damage and looted shops
summary: Parisians awoke to significant damage and looted stores following a night of unrest. Violence erupted across France during demonstrations over school conditions and the cost of living. The accompanying video captures the aftermath of the protests in the capital.

headline: Polanski says he will not overturn Green Party's 'Zionism is racism' motion
summary: The Green Party leader stated he would not overturn a controversial motion labeling 'Zionism is racism'. He indicated a desire to amend the motion but confirmed it would remain in effect until 2028. The decision has sparked internal and external debate for the party.

headline: Ending corridor care in hospitals for children a priority, says health secretary
summary: The health secretary has made ending corridor care for children in hospitals a top priority. Yvette Cooper announced a £140m investment in England's urgent care system. The funding aims to bolster hospital capacity and care ahead of the winter season.
